You are building the CREATOR DASHBOARD for a Next.js 16 clone of naano.com. Repo: /Users/raju/work/assignment-8x.

STEP 1 — Read /Users/raju/work/assignment-8x/docs/AGENT_KIT.md IN FULL and obey shared components, conventions, data model, and HARD RULES (don't modify shared files/libs; don't run npm install/dev/build; create new files only; @/ = src/). The creator app layout (src/app/creator/layout.tsx) already wraps your pages in DashboardShell and enforces auth via requireCreator(). Inside pages call `const { creator } = await requireCreator()` to get the current CreatorProfile. ALWAYS scope queries to `creator.id` and verify ownership on mutations (a booking must have creatorProfileId === creator.id, else not-found).

YOUR ASSIGNED FILES (create only these; new files only):
- src/app/creator/page.tsx — Overview.
- src/app/creator/deals/page.tsx — incoming + active deals.
- src/app/creator/deals/[id]/page.tsx — deal detail + content submission.
- src/app/creator/profile/page.tsx — media-kit editor.
- src/app/creator/earnings/page.tsx — payouts & earnings.
- src/app/actions/creator.ts — server actions ("use server").
- Client components under src/components/creator/ as needed.

PAGES:
OVERVIEW (/creator): PageHeader "Overview". KPI StatCards: available-to-book toggle status, active deals count, total earned (sum of PAID payouts), total post performance (impressions/clicks/leads across the creator's LIVE/COMPLETED/PAID bookings). A recent-performance chart (recharts, "use client") of impressions/clicks over time from this creator's bookings' PostMetricDaily. A list of pending invites (bookings with status INVITED) with quick Accept/Decline. Show the creator's own rate card (pricePerPost) and profile completeness hint.
DEALS (/creator/deals): sections — "New invites" (INVITED: Accept / Decline buttons via server actions acceptDeal/declineDeal), "In progress" (ACCEPTED/DRAFT_SUBMITTED/APPROVED/SCHEDULED), "Live" (LIVE/COMPLETED/PAID). Each deal card shows the brand/campaign name, price/post (formatEuros), fit, deliverable summary, and status Badge. Card links to /creator/deals/[id].
DEAL DETAIL (/creator/deals/[id]): verify booking.creatorProfileId === creator.id else notFound(). Show the campaign + brief (angle, hook, cta, keyMessages, doList, dontList, toneOfVoice — read from campaign.brief). If INVITED: Accept/Decline. If ACCEPTED (or DRAFT rejected): a content submission form (textarea for draftContent) → server action submitDraft sets status DRAFT_SUBMITTED. Show a status timeline. If LIVE: show the tracked link /t/<slug> and performance (impressions/clicks/leads). If PAID: show payout details.
PROFILE / MEDIA KIT (/creator/profile): an editable form for headline, bio, location, verticals (multi via checkboxes or comma input), pricePerPost, available (toggle) → server action updateCreatorProfile (validate with zod, ownership implicit = current creator). Below the form (read-only) show the media-kit preview: followers, median reach, engagement rate, avg reactions/comments, audience breakdown by Function & Seniority (ProgressBar rows via asAudienceMap), and recent posts. Keep the audience/stats read-only (seeded), only the editable fields above are writable.
EARNINGS (/creator/earnings): total earned (PAID), pending (PENDING/PROCESSING), a payouts table (amount, status, method SEPA, paidAt, source campaign/creator post), and messaging "Paid within 24h · Keep 100% of what you earn · No invoice, no chasing".

SERVER ACTIONS (src/app/actions/creator.ts): "use server"; acceptDeal(bookingId) INVITED→ACCEPTED, declineDeal(bookingId) INVITED→DECLINED, submitDraft(bookingId, content) ACCEPTED→DRAFT_SUBMITTED, updateCreatorProfile(data), toggleAvailability(). All validate input (zod), verify the booking/profile belongs to the current creator (requireCreator), enforce allowed transitions, and revalidatePath.

QUALITY: polished, responsive, on-brand, good empty states. Use PageHeader on each page. All must typecheck — run `npx tsc --noEmit` and fix errors in YOUR files (ignore errors from files other agents haven't created yet). 

Return a concise report of files created + the deal state transitions implemented.

2	
3	You are building part of a **Next.js 16 (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind v4 + Prisma + Auth.js** clone of naano.com, a B2B LinkedIn creator marketplace. A foundation is already built. **Reuse it. Do not rebuild or modify shared files.**
4	
5	## Hard rules
6	
7	- **Do NOT modify** any of these (they are shared & stable): `src/app/globals.css`, `src/app/layout.tsx`, `package.json`, anything in `prisma/`, anything in `src/lib/`, `src/components/ui/*`, `src/components/logo.tsx`, `src/components/marketing/site-nav.tsx`, `src/components/marketing/site-footer.tsx`, `src/components/app/*`, `src/auth.ts`, and the route-group layouts (`src/app/(marketing)/layout.tsx`, `src/app/(auth)/layout.tsx`, `src/app/app/layout.tsx`, `src/app/creator/layout.tsx`, `src/app/agency/layout.tsx`). Create **new files only, in your assigned directories.**
8	- **Do NOT run** `npm install`, `npm run dev`, or `npm run build`. All deps are installed; the orchestrator verifies centrally. You MAY run `npx tsc --noEmit` to check types if useful, but it's optional.
9	- If you think you need a new npm package, DON'T — use what's installed (recharts, lucide-react, zod, date-fns, ai, clsx, tailwind-merge, class-variance-authority) or note it in your final report.
10	- Path alias: `@/` → `src/`.
11	
12	## Stack conventions
13	
14	- **Server Components by default.** Add `"use client"` only for interactivity (state, event handlers, hooks).
15	- **Async params/searchParams** (Next 16): `export default async function Page({ params, searchParams }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }>; searchParams: Promise<Record<string,string|undefined>> }) { const { id } = await params; }`
16	- **Do NOT use** the global `LayoutProps`/`PageProps` types (they break standalone typecheck) — type props explicitly as shown above.
17	- **DB access** via `import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"`. Always scope queries to the authenticated user (never trust client-supplied ids for ownership) — IDOR-safe. Return/redirect (404-style) if a record isn't owned by the current user.
18	- **Mutations** = server actions in `src/app/actions/<name>.ts` starting with `"use server"`. Validate inputs with `zod`. Call `revalidatePath(...)` after writes. Enforce role/ownership inside the action (default-deny) — never rely on the UI hiding a control.
19	- **Money** is stored as whole euros (integer). Render with `formatEuros`.
20	- **Security guardrails to honor**: server-side authz on every action/route; validate all external input with zod; never put secrets in code; rely on React's auto-escaping (never `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` with user/AI data); use explicit DTOs (don't spread a whole request body into a Prisma create — pick allowed fields).
21	
22	## Design language
23	
24	Deep-navy hero (`.hero-clouds` bg), near-black pill CTAs, airy white sections, clean grotesque type (Plus Jakarta Sans, the default `font-sans`).
25	
26	Tailwind color utilities available: `bg-navy` `bg-navy-800` `bg-ink` `text-brand` `text-brand-700` `text-accent` `bg-brand` `bg-accent` `bg-muted` `text-muted-foreground` `border-border` `text-success/warning/danger`. Helpers: `.hero-clouds`, `.text-gradient`, `.bg-dotgrid`. Radius: `rounded-lg` / `rounded-xl` / `rounded-full`.
27	
28	## UI components (import from these paths)
29	
30	- `@/components/ui/button` → `Button` and `ButtonLink`. Variants: `default` (near-black), `brand`, `outline`, `subtle`, `ghost`, `white`, `danger`, `link`. Sizes: `sm|default|lg|icon`. `ButtonLink` takes `href` + all Link props.

32	- `@/components/ui/input` → `Input`. `@/components/ui/textarea` → `Textarea`. `@/components/ui/label` → `Label`.

46	## Utilities & constants
47	
48	- `@/lib/utils` → `cn`, `formatEuros`, `formatCompact`, `formatPercentFromFraction`, `formatScore`, `formatDate`, `initials`.
49	- `@/lib/constants` → `SITE`, `MARKETPLACE_STATS`, `PRICING_PLANS`, `VERTICALS`, `AUDIENCE_FUNCTIONS`, `AUDIENCE_SENIORITIES`, `CREATOR_WORTH`, `DELIVERY_RATES`, `PRICE_BANDS`, `MIN_POST_PRICE`, `MAX_POST_PRICE`, `BOOKING_PIPELINE`, `PAGE_SIZE_DEFAULT`, `PAGE_SIZE_MAX`.

51	
52	## Auth

54	- `@/lib/auth-helpers` → `getSessionUser()`, `requireAuth()`, `requireRole(role|roles)`, `requireCompany()` → `{user, company}`, `requireCreator()` → `{user, creator}`, `requireAgency()` → `{user, agency}`, `roleHome(role)`.

59	
60	- `User { id, email, name, role: COMPANY|CREATOR|AGENCY|ADMIN, image }`
61	- `CompanyProfile { id, userId, companyName, website, industry, vertical, icpDescription, icpFunctions[], icpSeniorities[], plan }`
62	- `CreatorProfile { id, userId?, displayName, headline, bio, avatarUrl?, location, verticals[], followers, medianReach, engagementRate, avgReactions, avgComments, pricePerPost, currency, available, audienceBySeniority(Json), audienceByFunction(Json), statsUpdatedAt, managedByAgencyId?, posts[] }`
63	- `CreatorPost { id, creatorProfileId, content, imageUrl?, reactions, comments, postedAt }`
64	- `AgencyProfile { id, userId, agencyName, type: BRAND_AGENCY|CREATOR_AGENCY, clientWorkspaces[], rosterCreators[] }`
65	- `AgencyClientWorkspace { id, agencyProfileId, clientName, budget, companies[], campaigns[] }`
66	- `Campaign { id, companyProfileId, agencyClientWorkspaceId?, name, status: DRAFT|ACTIVE|COMPLETED|ARCHIVED, vertical, icp, objective, budget, targetPostCount, startDate?, endDate?, brief?, bookings[] }`
67	- `Brief { id, campaignId, angle, hook, cta, keyMessages[], audience, toneOfVoice, doList[], dontList[], proofPoints[], generatedByAI, prompt? }`
68	- `Booking { id, campaignId, creatorProfileId, status: INVITED|ACCEPTED|DECLINED|DRAFT_SUBMITTED|APPROVED|SCHEDULED|LIVE|COMPLETED|PAID, pricePerPost, fitScore, trackedSlug (unique), targetUrl, draftContent?, scheduledAt?, publishedAt?, metrics[], leads[], payout? }`

71	- `Payout { id, bookingId, amount, currency, status: PENDING|PROCESSING|PAID, method, paidAt? }`
